load_mesh_from_file: load a mesh from an OBJ, OFF, or PLY file using IO().load_mesh(path)
save_mesh_to_file: save a single Meshes object to a file using IO().save_mesh(data, path)
load_pointcloud_from_file: load a point cloud from a PLY file using IO().load_pointcloud(path)
save_pointcloud_to_file: save a single Pointclouds object to a file using IO().save_pointcloud(data, path)
register_custom_mesh_format: register a custom MeshFormatInterpreter with IO().register_meshes_format(interpreter)
